raw_segments.text: It was then eight o'clock. At half-past nine, it being then high-tide, the Carnatic would
leave the harbor. Mr. Fogg and Eeyuda got into the Palanquin, their luggage being brought
after on a wheelbarrow, and half an hour later stepped upon the key whence they were to embark.
Mr. Fogg then learned that the Carnatic had sailed the evening before. He had expected
to find not only the steamer, but his domestic, and was forced to give up both, but no sign
of disappointment appeared on his face, and he merely remarked to Eeyuda,
It is an accident, madam, nothing more.
